name: 3D Wavelet-based Encoder with Multi-Component Transformation
definition: A 3D wavelet encoding scheme that applies a lifting-based wavelet transform along the component axis (Y, U, V) and spatially, using different filters for luminance and chrominance to remove correlations and compress data.
summary: This method compresses volumetric data by applying a lifting-based wavelet transform along the component axis to remove inter-component correlations before spatial decomposition, distinguishing it from standard 3D transforms.
